messages:
Anna (Product): Kicking off a cross-team thread to align on the long-term routing + multi-region + tenant isolation initiative. Need product priorities, customer asks, and minimal launch criteria.
Mike (Eng-Platform): Quick Q — are we prioritizing tenant-first routing (strong isolation) or region-first routing (latency)? different infra tradeoffs.
Sofia (Eng-Runtime): Leaning region-first for latency SLOs, but we can support tenant slices later. Runtime changes: per-tenant routing table, KV cache partitioning, fallback variants.
Raj (Security): Isolation must include KMS scoping, per-tenant audit logs, and network boundaries for regulated customers. Can't ship without those controls.
Lena (Customer Success): Two enterprise customers asked for strict tenant network isolation + SLA. They're willing to pay for Dedicated with per-tenant pools.
Jorge (SRE): Ops concerns: multi-region increases failover surface and test matrix. We need a staged rollout plan, chaos tests, and staging mirrors.
Anna (Product): Proposed MVP scope: 1) region-aware routing policy, 2) tenant affinity toggle (opt-in), 3) automatic fallback to compatible lower-cost model. Launch criteria (short list): latency delta <=10% baseline, failover recover <60s, runbook + docs published.
Mike (Eng-Platform): Tech spec sketch:
```yaml
route_policy:
  - match: tenant_id: "id-*"
    region_preference: ["us-west-2","us-east-1"]
    fallback: "model-small"
```
Sofia (Eng-Runtime): Runtime implications: continuous batching per-region, per-tenant KV partitioning to avoid cross-tenant leakage, and variant tagging for quantized models.
Raj (Security): Also need config fields for per-tenant KMS key id and an audit endpoint. Add HSM flag for customers that need it.
Lena (Customer Success): Prioritization ask from CS: start with customers that require in-region data residency and KMS separation. Can we schedule a POC in Q3?
Anna (Product): Proposed prioritization: Phase 1 (Q3) region-aware routing + per-tenant affinity toggle for Dedicated; Phase 2 (Q4) tenant-isolated pools + private-deploy integration + expanded telemetry.
Jorge (SRE): Rollout plan idea: internal alpha in us-west (single cluster), perf + chaos testing, two-region beta with synthetic load, then customer pilots. Need runbooks for failover and rollback.
Mike (Eng-Platform): Risk notes: stateful KV migration, cache invalidation, cost model shift (tokens/second in multi-region). We'll need telemetry metrics: cost/token delta, tail latency by region, cross-tenant KV misses.
Anna (Product): Owners: ENG-PLATFORM (Mike), RUNTIME (Sofia), SECURITY (Raj), SRE (Jorge), CS (Lena). Action items: write spec doc, produce cost estimate, shortlist pilot customers. @Lena can you collect 2 customers this week?
Lena (Customer Success): Yep, will ping them today and share contact + requirements. :+1:
opsbot: deploy-bot: Created epic INFRA-2371 for routing-region-affinity and added initial labels.
Anna (Product): Great. I'll schedule a 30m scoping sync Thu 10am and post an agenda. Thanks all.
